name: Badacsonytördemic (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Badacsonytördemic (a red and blue shield with a fish, a crozier and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the words BADACSONYTÖRDEMIC 1219–1996 in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Badacsonytördemic arms with helm, crest and mantling
